page.layout: One page of text, one column, with running head "LIBER II" at the top and page number 249 at the top right. No margin notes. Catchword "Clau-" at the lower right, gathering signature "Q v." at the foot left.

main_text.p: 1. Quod peftis infligatur à Deo: Inde manus, gladius, fagittæ Dei, &c.

2. Quod per caufas fecundas angelos bonos, malos. Oftendatur hunc bonum fuiffe, quia poftea mittitur ad prophetam: & per naturales alias; aftrorum pofitus, coniunctiones, meteora, ventos, eluviones, putredines, &c.
3. Quod dirigatur manu Dei, ut non fæviat promifcuè, nec diutius quam Deus vult, &c.
4. Quod Deus non [illegible, ~10 letters], bonus, mifericors in pœnis: nec modum excedat: folus etiam cohibere poteft. Ergo, &c.

11. Quid David fecerit ad avertendam peftem: confpecto percuffore confternatus cum fenioribus precatur: agnofcit culpam: petit parci populo: juffus exftruit altare in area emta precio, & facrificia offert.
Per occupationem explicetur quæftio, Cur David author mali non fit mortuus: & an non populo innocenti iniufte irrogata plaga.
Poftea deducatur hypothefis: quid pefte faciendum ut avertatur.
1. Agnitio manus Dei: etfi non femper appareat angelus percuffor: apparent aliæ caufæ, alia figna iræ Dei.
4. Exftructio altaris, quæ eft fiducia Chrifti mediatoris: Hic enim altare noftrum. Hebr. 13.

page.notes: Greek word in thesis 4 (after "Quod Deus non") is printed in Greek and is too faint to read reliably; left as illegible. The mark before "Agnitio" in thesis 1 and 2 is a small symbol, not transcribed. The catchword "Clau-" and signature "Q v." at the foot are as printed. "Hebr. 13." is printed as "Hebr.13." with a small gap.
